theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.argumentPrinciple_annulus_finset (u : ℂ → ℂ) (S : Finset ℂ) (m : ℂ → ℕ) {A : Set ℂ} (r R : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R) (hAopen : IsOpen A) (hAsub : Metric.closedBall 0 R \ Metric.ball 0 r ⊆ A) (hu : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ u A) (hune : ∀ z ∈ A, u z ≠ 0) (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, r < ‖a‖ ∧ ‖a‖ < R) :
((∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (∏ a ∈ S, (w - a) ^ m a) * u w) z / ((∏ a ∈ S, (z - a) ^ m a) * u z)) - ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, r), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (∏ a ∈ S, (w - a) ^ m a) * u w) z / ((∏ a ∈ S, (z - a) ^ m a) * u z)) = (∑ a ∈ S, ↑(m a)) * (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.argumentPrinciple_annulus_filter (u : ℂ → ℂ) (S : Finset ℂ) (m : ℂ → ℕ) {A : Set ℂ} (r R : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R) (hAopen : IsOpen A) (hAsub : Metric.closedBall 0 R \ Metric.ball 0 r ⊆ A) (hu : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ u A) (hune : ∀ z ∈ A, u z ≠ 0) (hS : ∀ a ∈ S, ‖a‖ ≠ r ∧ ‖a‖ ≠ R) :
((∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (∏ a ∈ S, (w - a) ^ m a) * u w) z / ((∏ a ∈ S, (z - a) ^ m a) * u z)) - ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, r), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (∏ a ∈ S, (w - a) ^ m a) * u w) z / ((∏ a ∈ S, (z - a) ^ m a) * u z)) = (∑ a ∈ S with r < ‖a‖ ∧ ‖a‖ < R, ↑(m a)) * (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.logDeriv_prod_pow_sub_mul (u : ℂ → ℂ) (S : Finset ℂ) (m : ℂ → ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : ∀ a ∈ S, z ≠ a) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℂ u z) (hun : u z ≠ 0) :
logDeriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (∏ a ∈ S, (w - a) ^ m a) * u w) z = ∑ a ∈ S, ↑(m a) * (z - a)⁻¹ + logDeriv u z

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.multiplicity_eq_one_of_winding_step (u : ℂ → ℂ) (a : ℂ) (m : ℕ) {A : Set ℂ} (r R : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R) (hAopen : IsOpen A) (hAsub : Metric.closedBall 0 R \ Metric.ball 0 r ⊆ A) (hu : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ u A) (hune : ∀ z ∈ A, u z ≠ 0) (har : r < ‖a‖) (haR : ‖a‖ < R) (hwind : ((∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z / (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z) - ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, r), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z / (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z) = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I) :
m = 1

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.argumentPrinciple_annulus_single (u : ℂ → ℂ) (a : ℂ) (m : ℕ) {A : Set ℂ} (r R : ℝ) (hr : 0 < r) (hrR : r < R) (hAopen : IsOpen A) (hAsub : Metric.closedBall 0 R \ Metric.ball 0 r ⊆ A) (hu : AnalyticOnNhd ℂ u A) (hune : ∀ z ∈ A, u z ≠ 0) (har : r < ‖a‖) (haR : ‖a‖ < R) :
((∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z / (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z) - ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, r), deriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z / (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z) = ↑m * (2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I)

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.logDeriv_pow_sub_mul (u : ℂ → ℂ) (a : ℂ) (m : ℕ) (z : ℂ) (hz : z ≠ a) (hu : DifferentiableAt ℂ u z) (hun : u z ≠ 0) :
logDeriv (fun (w : ℂ) => (w - a) ^ m * u w) z = ↑m * (z - a)⁻¹ + logDeriv u z

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.integral_inv_sub_outside (a : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (hR : 0 ≤ R) (ha : R < ‖a‖) :
(∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), (z - a)⁻¹) = 0

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.integral_inv_sub_inside (a : ℂ) (R : ℝ) (ha : ‖a‖ < R) :
(∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), (z - a)⁻¹) = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.qTheta_winding_step (P : ℝ) (hP : 1 < P) (ρ : ℝ) (hρ : 0 < ρ) (hne : ∀ (z : ℂ), ‖z‖ = ρ → qThetaC P z ≠ 0) :
(∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, P ^ 2 * ρ), deriv (qThetaC P) z / qThetaC P z) = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I + ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, ρ), deriv (qThetaC P) z / qThetaC P z

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.winding_step (g : ℂ → ℂ) (a R : ℝ) (hR : 0 < R) (hint : CircleIntegrable g 0 R) (hstep : ∀ (z : ℂ), ‖z‖ = R → ↑a * g (↑a * z) = z⁻¹ + g z) :
(∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, a * R), g z) = 2 * ↑Real.pi * Complex.I + ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), g z

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.circleIntegral_scale (f : ℂ → ℂ) (a R : ℝ) :
(∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, a * R), f z) = ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(0, R), ↑a * f (↑a * z)

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.logDeriv_qThetaC_functional_equation (P : ℝ) (hP : 1 < P) (w : ℂ) (hw : w ≠ 0) (hθ : qThetaC P w ≠ 0) :
↑P ^ 2 * deriv (qThetaC P) (↑P ^ 2 * w) / qThetaC P (↑P ^ 2 * w) = 1 / w + deriv (qThetaC P) w / qThetaC P w

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.deriv_qThetaC_functional_equation (P : ℝ) (hP : 1 < P) (w : ℂ) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
↑P ^ 2 * deriv (qThetaC P) (↑P ^ 2 * w) = qThetaC P w + w * deriv (qThetaC P) w

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.qThetaC_functional_equation (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (w : ℂ) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
qThetaC P (↑P ^ 2 * w) = w * qThetaC P w

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.differentiableOn_qThetaC (P : ℝ) (hP : 1 < P) :
DifferentiableOn ℂ (qThetaC P) {0}ᶜ

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.norm_le_annulus (P r R : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hr : 0 < r) (w : ℂ) (hw1 : r ≤ ‖w‖) (hw2 : ‖w‖ ≤ R) (n : ℤ) :
‖qThetaCTerm P w n‖ ≤ qThetaTerm P R n + qThetaTerm P r n

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.norm_qThetaCTerm (P : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (w : ℂ) (n : ℤ) :
‖qThetaCTerm P w n‖ = qThetaTerm P ‖w‖ n

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.qThetaC_ofReal (P w : ℝ) :
qThetaC P ↑w = ↑(qTheta P w)

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.qThetaC_eq_tsum (P : ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
qThetaC P w = ∑' (n : ℤ), qThetaCTerm P w n

ℂ

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.qTheta_inversion (P w : ℝ) (hw : w ≠ 0) :
qTheta P (1 / w) = w * qTheta P w

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.connRatio_reflect (P : ℝ) (a z : ℂ) :
qThetaC P ((starRingEnd ℂ) z / a) * qThetaC P (-(starRingEnd ℂ) z / (starRingEnd ℂ) a) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (qThetaC P (-z / a) * qThetaC P (z / (starRingEnd ℂ) a))

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.thetaRatio_multiplier (P c z : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (hc : c ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
qTheta P (P ^ 2 * (c * z)) * qTheta P z = c * (qTheta P (c * z) * qTheta P (P ^ 2 * z))

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.connRatio_elliptic (P a b z : ℝ) (hP : 0 < P) (ha : a ≠ 0) (hb : b ≠ 0) (hz : z ≠ 0) :
qTheta P (P ^ 2 * z / a) * qTheta P (-(P ^ 2 * z) / b) * (qTheta P (-z / a) * qTheta P (z / b)) = qTheta P (-(P ^ 2 * z) / a) * qTheta P (P ^ 2 * z / b) * (qTheta P (z / a) * qTheta P (-z / b))

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.norm_qThetaC_conj_pair (P z : ℝ) (t : ℂ) :
‖qThetaC P (↑z / (starRingEnd ℂ) t)‖ = ‖qThetaC P (↑z / t)‖

theorem QOU.QBeta.C1Poles.qThetaC_conj (P : ℝ) (w : ℂ) :
qThetaC P ((starRingEnd ℂ) w) = (starRingEnd ℂ) (qThetaC P w)
